proposed.text: A new owner asks an architect to remodel a building designed by another architect. What source-safe rule applies?

options.text: Notify the prior architect of the contemplated project
No notice is required because ownership changed
Claim authorship of the whole building if the remodel is visible

proposed.rationale: For additions, rehabilitation, or remodeling of an erected structure previously undertaken by another architect, the Code requires notice even when the owner is no longer the same.
